Work in C:\Users\edmem\kodely-prod (Next.js 16 + Prisma, an AI website builder called Kodely).

BUILD: an admin audit log, and surface it.

## Why
Admin surfaces show cost, margin, customer prompts and personal data. There is currently no record of who looked at what. "Which admin viewed this account" has no answer today.

## Schema already exists — use it, do not change it
`AdminAuditLog` in prisma/schema.prisma (READ ONLY): `id, actorId, actorEmail, action, targetType, targetId, meta Json?, createdAt`, indexed on `[actorId, createdAt]`, `[action, createdAt]`, `[targetType, targetId]`. Append-only by convention.

## Scope — YOU MAY ONLY CREATE/EDIT: `lib/admin-audit.ts`, `app/admin/audit/**`
Do NOT edit `app/admin/page.tsx`, `app/admin/layout.tsx`, or `app/admin/users/**` — other work owns those. READ them to match idiom (especially `getAdminUser()` from lib/auth.ts and the table/stat-tile patterns in `app/admin/page.tsx`).

## Build
1. **`lib/admin-audit.ts`** — a `recordAdminAction()` helper and a closed `ADMIN_ACTIONS` vocabulary (dotted, past-tense: `user.viewed`, `site.taken_down`, `flag.changed`). Model it on `lib/events.ts` (READ ONLY) — same discipline: closed name set, small non-PII `meta`, never prompt bodies or generated content. Unlike `track()` in events.ts, decide deliberately whether an audit write should be fire-and-forget or awaited, and justify it in a comment — a dropped analytics event is a gap in a chart, a dropped audit row is a gap in an accountability record.
2. **`app/admin/audit/page.tsx`** — a readable log: when, who, what action, what target (linked where it makes sense), meta. Filter by actor and by action, paginated, newest first. Match the existing admin visual idiom exactly (`rounded-xl border border-black/10 dark:border-white/10`, `text-sm`, `tabular-nums`, monochrome).
3. Call `getAdminUser()` at the top of every page you create and `notFound()` if null — the layout gates the section, but Next's docs say a layout must not be the sole authorization boundary.

## Also produce (do not implement)
A short section in your report listing every existing admin surface that SHOULD be recording an action but currently isn't, with file paths — so whoever owns those files can add the calls. Do not edit those files.

## Constraints
- DO NOT modify: prisma/schema.prisma, anything under lib/ except lib/admin-audit.ts, app/api/**, app/admin/page.tsx, app/admin/layout.tsx, app/admin/users/**, app/projects/**, app/dashboard/**, app/settings/**, app/legal/**, app/blog/**, app/globals.css, proxy.ts, deploy.sh, .env, package.json.
- No new npm dependencies. Do NOT run `npm run build`, `git commit`, `git push`, or `deploy.sh`.
- Do NOT add white text on the brand gradient — it fails contrast and that is a known accepted issue.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` AND `npx eslint app lib components` must BOTH be clean. The repo is at zero lint errors and must stay there. Other agents are running in parallel, so if you see errors in files you did not touch, they are not yours — leave them.
- Local Postgres is available (DATABASE_URL in .env). Read-only, plus rows you create and clean up yourself.

## Report back
What you built, your fire-and-forget vs awaited decision and why, the list of surfaces that should be logging but aren't, and what you verified.
